answer: Vesting with clawback: new agents earn rewards that unlock at a glacier pace over weeks, held in escrow rather than paid out. If audits later link an identity to a sybil cluster, its unvested balance is clawed back to the pool. An attacker spinning up an atlas of fake accounts must fund and operate each one for the whole vesting window, yet sees nothing liquid until it ends, so the expected payout from the scheme plateaus like a mesa while costs keep climbing.
